methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched and verified via WebFetch on 2026-06-15: taxjar.com/pricing, quaderno.io/pricing, stripe.com/tax/pricing plus the US support article support.stripe.com/questions/understanding-stripe-tax-pricing, anrok.com/pricing, numeral.com/pricing, vatcompliance.co/prices/sales-tax/, avalara.com/us/en/products/pricing.html, sovos.com, and vertexinc.com/integrations. Stripe Tax Complete USD tiers ($90/$430/$1000/$1500) and the $0.50 Transaction-API / $0.05 Calculation-API rates were confirmed against the US Stripe support article; the public stripe.com/tax/pricing page geolocates to EUR (€80/€400/€930/€1400, €0.45/€0.04), so USD figures are retained from the US article. LOVAT officially rebranded to Lappa effective 2026-03-20 (confirmed: vatcompliance.co/blog/lovat-is-now-lappa and lappa.org); vatcompliance.co remains the active pricing domain, so plan slug retained. Avalara, Sovos, and Vertex do not publish self-serve software prices and are listed with monthlyUsd:null; speculative third-party annual-price RANGES were removed from notes (never published by the vendor). All EUR-denominated plans (LOVAT/Lappa) and all per-filing/per-transaction models are captured in plan notes with monthlyUsd:null rather than converted/guessed. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Starts at 200 orders/month; price scales up with order volume tiers. Up to 3 data-import integrations, 2 AutoFile credits/year ($50 each additional), email support, 10 team users. Annual plans save 10%+. Flex fees allow temporary tier upgrades. State registration $299 each.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Starts at 200 orders/month; price scales with volume. Up to 10 total integrations (data-import + API), real-time API calculations, 4 AutoFile credits/year ($55 each additional), phone + email support, dedicated onboarding and Customer Success Manager, 10 team users. Annual plans save 10%+.
